summary: Iteration 11 short regression of NexusHesap. Units: GET /api/products/units returns 17 defaults with int counts (Adet count>0), POST 'Rulo' adds, PUT renames to 'Rulo2', DELETE removes it, empty name -> 400, DELETE used unit 'Adet' -> 400 and unit preserved. Categories: add/delete unused works, delete used category -> 400. FRONTEND (Playwright, preview URL): /settings?tab=units renders units-box (17 chips w/ counts) + categories-box; add via Ekle button, pencil rename via prompt, units-box-del-* delete of unused unit, used-unit delete shows 'Bu birimi kullanan ürünler var…' error toast and used-category delete shows 'Bu kategoride ürün var…' error toast — all correct, EXCEPT units-box-input/categories-box-input lose focus after every keystroke (only 'R' of 'Rulo' registered) so Enter-to-add is effectively broken for multi-character names. /stock: product-units-list datalist has 17 units + 7 categories, new-product-unit input bound to it, edit-unit-input in ProductEditForm also bound and editable. /orders: convert-inv-btn-<no> opens inv-type-chooser-<no> with e_invoice/e_archive/paper + inv-chooser-approve for pending orders; choosing 'Kağıt Fatura' created invoice NX202614187272 (verified e_type=paper in API) and the row switched to 'Faturalandı'. Bulk: selecting only invoiced orders -> info toast 'Seçili siparişlerin tümü zaten faturalanmış.'; bulk-approve on non-pending -> info toast 'Seçili siparişlerde onaylanacak (beklemede) sipariş yok.'. /portal/<token>: add product -> b2b-submit-order -> POST 200, b2b-order-done banner 'Siparişiniz alındı: B2B-2026-0013' and the order visible in Siparişlerim (2) — regression fixed. All test data removed (orders back to 11, invoices 22, units 17, no Rulo/TEST_ categories, no geliver config).

minor.issue: Portal 'Siparişlerim' filters by contact_id only, so the legacy seeded order B2B-2026-004 (same customer_name 'Trend Mağazacılık…', no contact_id) is invisible to the customer. Consider falling back to customer_name or backfilling contact_id.

Response returns only {status,message,invoice_id} (no invoice object) while /quotes/{id}/convert-to-invoice returns the full invoice — inconsistent API shape. Also server.py:3292 sets 'e_type':'e_archive' and then re-sets 'e_type' at 3297 in the same dict literal (duplicate key, dead code).
Still hardcodes unit 'Adet', vat_rate 20 and payment_status='paid'/paid_amount=grand_total for every converted order; subtotal/vat computed by /1.20 regardless of item VAT.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: the inner `Box` component is declared inside UnitsCategories, so a new component type is created on every render; each keystroke re-renders the parent and React unmounts/remounts the subtree, so the text input loses focus after the first character (typing 'Rulo' leaves 'R'). Units/categories cannot be added by typing + Enter. Fix: move `Box` outside UnitsCategories (or memoize it) and keep local input state inside it.

The chooser is positioned with `bottom-full` (opens upward); for the first table row the top option 'E-Fatura' is clipped/hidden by the table container so only E-Arşiv / Kağıt Fatura / Önce Onayla are visible. Flip direction when there is no room above.

React console error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' when the product edit modal opens (option children wrapped by dynamic expression spans). Cosmetic/dev-only but pollutes the console.

issues: Unit/category chips use only a tiny pencil/trash icon (12px) with grey-400 on white — low contrast and small hit area.
No inline validation feedback for duplicate names (silent upsert).
Active company label still reads 'MATEK DEKORASYON' while all requests use comp_nexus_main_01 (reported since iteration 6).

action_items: HIGH: move the `Box` sub-component out of UnitsCategories in SettingsPage.jsx — the input currently loses focus after each keystroke, blocking unit/category creation by typing.
MEDIUM: make inv-type-chooser flip below the button when there is not enough space above (first row's 'E-Fatura' option is clipped).
LOW: remove the duplicate 'e_type' key in convert_order_to_invoice (server.py:3292 vs 3297) and return the created invoice object for API consistency; stop hardcoding unit/vat/payment_status.
LOW: portal order list should also match orders by customer_name (or backfill contact_id on seeded B2B orders); fix the <span> inside <option> React warning in ProductEditForm.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPage.jsx:113 — component defined inside a component (classic React remount anti-pattern) causing the focus-loss bug; also duplicated add/rename/delete logic could stay in one stable memoized component.
server.py convert_order_to_invoice builds a dict literal with 'e_type' twice; static analysis/linters would flag this and the first value is silently dropped.

server.py is 3828 lines — units/categories, cargo, orders and reports should be split into routers; GET /products/units performs one count_documents per unit (N+1, 17 queries per call) — use a single aggregation.
OrdersB2BPage bulk() now correctly skips (o.is_invoiced || o.invoice_id) and shows info toasts — verified; keep this guard in sync with the backend.

rca_of_the_issue: Units/categories input focus loss: `const Box = ({...}) => (...)` is declared in the body of UnitsCategories, so its function identity changes on every parent render. Because the input's value lives in the parent state (nu/nc), each keystroke re-renders UnitsCategories, React sees a different component type and unmounts/remounts the whole Box subtree, destroying the focused <input>. Repro: click units-box-input and type 'Rulo' with a delay -> only 'R' remains. Fix: hoist Box to module scope (props already passed in) or keep the draft value in Box's own state.
